definitions.gloss: vinegared dish, food dressed with vinegar
definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese dishes made with vinegar-based dressing, often served cold as a refreshing side dish.

examples.japanese: {胡瓜|きゅうり}の{酢|す}の{物|もの}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a cucumber vinegared dish.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{酢|す}の{物|もの}がさっぱりして{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: In summer, vinegared dishes taste refreshingly light.

examples.japanese: {酢|す}の{物|もの}は{食欲|しょくよく}がないときでも{食|た}べやすいです。
examples.english: Vinegared dishes are easy to eat even when you don't have much appetite.

examples.japanese: {蛸|たこ}と{胡瓜|きゅうり}の{酢|す}の{物|もの}は、おつまみにぴったりです。
examples.english: Octopus and cucumber vinegared dish is perfect as a drinking snack.

examples.japanese: {和食|わしょく}の{献立|こんだて}には、{口|くち}をさっぱりさせるために{酢|す}の{物|もの}が{一品|いっぴん}{加|くわ}わることが{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: A vinegared dish is often included in a Japanese meal to cleanse the palate.

notes:
{酢|す}の{物|もの} refers to dishes dressed with vinegar-based seasonings.

Common types:
- {酢|す}の{物|もの} (basic vinegar dressing)
- {三杯酢|さんばいず} (soy sauce, vinegar, mirin mixture)
- {二杯酢|にはいず} (soy sauce and vinegar mixture)
- {甘酢|あまず} (sweet vinegar)
- {土佐酢|とさず} (vinegar with dashi)

Common ingredients:
- {胡瓜|きゅうり} (cucumber)
- {若布|わかめ} (wakame seaweed)
- {蛸|たこ} (octopus)
- もずく (mozuku seaweed)
- {海老|えび} (shrimp)

Characteristics:
- Light and refreshing
- Often served as a palate cleanser
- Typically cold dishes
- Common in summer meals
